mapper.select: SELECT bc.SEQBOARDCOMMENT AS seqBoardComment, bc.SEQBOARDPOST AS seqBoardPost, bc.SEQMEMBER AS seqMember, bc.CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(bc.CREATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createDate, TO_CHAR(bc.UPDATEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updateDate, bc.STATUS AS status, m.NAME AS writerName FROM BOARD_COMMENT bc INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON bc.SEQMEMBER = m.SEQMEMBER WHERE bc.SEQBOARDPOST = #{seqBoardPost} AND bc.STATUS = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY bc.SEQBOARDCOMMENT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_COMMENT ( SEQBOARDCOMMENT, SEQBOARDPOST, SEQMEMBER, CONTENT, CREATEDATE, UPDATEDATE, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQBOARDCOMMENT.NEXTVAL, #{seqBoardPost}, #{seqMember}, #{content}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 'NORMAL' )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_COMMENT SET CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATEDATE = SYSDATE WHERE SEQBOARDCOMMENT = #{seqBoardComment} AND STATUS = 'NORMAL'
UPDATE BOARD_COMMENT SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATEDATE = SYSDATE WHERE SEQBOARDCOMMENT = #{seqBoardComment} AND STATUS = 'NORMAL'
mapper.select: SELECT SEQMEMBER FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE SEQBOARDCOMMENT = #{seqBoardComment} AND STATUS = 'NORMAL'
